assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: a NEW photorealistic card image for the Olavinlinna game, not an edit of an existing image.
Input images: Image1 is the source-approved loading background, used ONLY for CASTLE GEOMETRY and tower/wall proportions. Image2 and Image3 are owner-provided v44z game3D shape renders, used ONLY as supplementary geometry references. Do not copy their sunset/daylight, graphic surfaces, black placeholder blocks, brown placeholder mounds, bridge, flags, or dark UI footer. Generate a completely new real-camera-looking NIGHT scene.

Subject: Olavinlinna on Kyrönsalmi lake in its OWNER-SPECIFIED1499 form. Match the approved background's THREE main round towers and long main west stone wall: Clock Tower is tallest and leftmost; Church Tower is behind the wall near the middle, shorter; St Erik Tower is smallest at the right, partly behind the wall. Dark conical period roofs and round upper openings, natural irregular granite masonry. Low and modest medieval eastern forecastle at right. Preserve these height relations and overall silhouette from the references; do not improvise a later fortress. Replace every rough model placeholder with natural shoreline granite and a low stone wall. NO bridge, dock, jetty, east battery, Clock Bastion, Water Gate Bastion, seventeenth-century additions, modern castle structures, modern lights, flags or signs. Exactly these three main towers, no extra new tower.

The main courtyard gate/arched passage in the low front wall visibly glows with modest warm candle/fire light from inside; two or three narrow windows can carry a faint warm glow. The doorway is EMPTY, no humanlike silhouette, guard or figure. The light reflects faintly on wet stone and nearby water. No bright spotlight, floodlight, torch rows, building fire, flames outside the doorway or exaggerated orange blaze.

Foreground: ONE traditional fifteenth-century narrow wooden rowing boat, weathered dark clinker planks, curved raised bow, open interior with bare cross benches. The boat is visibly EMPTY: no person, face, figure, dummy, bundled coat, blanket, sack or animal. A SMALL old iron/brass candle lantern is fixed at its forward bow, which points slightly toward the castle. Warm light touches the bow's wet wood and water immediately below it. No other boat lamp. Optional plain oars rest on its sides, never held by hands. No engine, sail, modern safetygear, plastic, branded fittings or writings. Entire boat and both ends inside the frame, with space around it.

Weather and light: midnight BLUE-GRAY twilight, light gentle rain with delicate narrow streaks and small circular raindrop ripples on the lake, low mist at water level around the castle's base. Mist softens the shore but does NOT cover the three-tower silhouette or whole wall. Dark cloudy lavender/slate-blue sky, no stars, no moon, no sunset colors, no sun rays. The ONLY warm sources are the gate, a few narrow windows and the single boat lantern. Natural muted photographic exposure: dark but readable, real wet stone/wood/water texture, no black empty graphic block, no fake UI gradient. Calm, expectant, mildly mysterious and welcoming, NOT frightening or cinematic horror.

Photographic style: convincing real-camera night photograph of a physical scene, natural lens perspective and depth, both castle and boat readable, believable light rain and subdued reflections. Not a painting, model render, miniature, CGI, fantasy game screenshot, HDR, orange-teal grading, oversaturated colors or glossy artificial texture. No text, letters, numbers, logos, signs, watermarks, border or caption pixels. No humans or faces ANYWHERE, no animals or birds, no violence. ONE image, no collage, no variants.
Composition: SQUARE, output1024 x1024 opaque RGB PNG, sRGB. Entire main castle including all three roof tips and long main wall in the BACKGROUND CENTER, roughly y22-55percent, with generous margins. Calm cloudy sky at top12percent. Empty boat in foreground slightly LEFT OF CENTER, about24percent of image width, hull centered near x35percent and y64percent; boat stays roughly in y55-70percent, not large across the bottom. Bow lantern clearly visible, gate glow clearly visible. The very bottom12percent is quiet open lake water with no important object, rather than an artificial black UI footer. Low normal water-level camera, quiet balanced square composition. Do not crop the castle or enlarge boat beyond30percentwidth.
